problems.title: Squares of quadratic roots
problems.question: $x_1,x_2$ solve $x^2-4x+1=0$. Find $x_1^2+x_2^2$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.

problems.title: Tangent and cotangent as roots
problems.question: Roots of $x^2-px+q=0$ are $\tan\alpha,\cot\alpha$, for acute $\alpha$. What must hold?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: For an acute angle both quantities are defined and nonzero. Their product is 1.

problems.title: Roots in a ratio of five
problems.question: Roots of $x^2+px+3=0$ have ratio 5. Find $|p|$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Write the roots as $t,5t$. Then $5t^2=3$, so $|t|=\sqrt{15}/5$.
The absolute value of their sum is $6|t|=6\sqrt{15}/5$.

problems.title: Tangent from coordinates
problems.question: $A=(1,1),B=(2,7),C=(9,1)$. Find $\tan BAC$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: $AC$ is horizontal. From $A$ to $B$, rise is $7-1=6$ and run is $2-1=1$. Thus the tangent is 6.

problems.title: Distance between clock hand tips
problems.question: At 2:00 the clock hands have lengths 10 and 5 cm. Find the tip-to-tip distance.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The hands form $60^\circ$. Thus $c^2=100+25-100(1/2)=75$.
Take the positive square root: $c=5\sqrt3$.

problems.title: A quadratic in absolute value
problems.question: Find the product of all real solutions of $x^2-|x|-6=0$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Factor $t^2-t-6=(t-3)(t+2)$. Only $t=3$ is nonnegative.
Thus $x=3,-3$ and their product is $-9$.

problems.title: The remainder theorem
problems.question: $P(x)=(x-1)(x-k)$ leaves remainder 19 on division by $x+1$. Find $k$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
formulas: The remainder on division by $x-c$ equals $P(c)$.

problems.title: A reciprocal quartic
problems.question: Find the sum of all real solutions of $x^4-2x^3-33x^2-2x+1=0$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Divide by $x^2$: $t^2-2t-35=0$, hence $t=7$ or $t=-5$.
The two resulting quadratics are $x^2-7x+1=0$ and $x^2+5x+1=0$. Both have two real roots; their root sums are 7 and $-5$. The total is 2.

problems.title: Count triangles from two sides and one angle
problems.question: Two sides have lengths 4 and 5, and some angle is $60^\circ$. How many noncongruent triangles are possible?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: If the $60^\circ$ angle is between the given sides, the third side is $\sqrt{21}$, giving one triangle.
If $60^\circ$ is opposite side 4, the sine of the angle opposite 5 would be $5\sqrt3/8>1$, impossible.
If $60^\circ$ is opposite side 5, the other angle has sine $2\sqrt3/5$. Its acute value works; its obtuse supplement added to $60^\circ$ exceeds $180^\circ$. This gives one more triangle.

problems.title: Circumradius and the largest side
problems.question: Triangle angles have ratio $1:2:6$, and circumradius is 10. Find the largest side.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The angles are $20^\circ,40^\circ,120^\circ$. The largest side is opposite $120^\circ$.
Its length is $20\sin120^\circ=10\sqrt3$.

problems.title: A constant root separation
problems.question: For which real $a$ do roots of $x^2-2(a+1)x+a(a+2)=0$ differ by 2?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The two roots are $a$ and $a+2$ for every real $a$. Their difference is always 2.

problems.title: Count real roots of a biquadratic
problems.question: How many real solutions does $x^4-(a^2+3)x^2+a^2+2=0$ have?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The solutions are $\pm1$ and $\pm\sqrt{a^2+2}$.
Since $a^2+2\ge2$, all four are real and distinct.

problems.title: Work rates with unknown completion time
problems.question: A master alone needs 1 hour more, and an apprentice 2 hours more, than the pair together. Find the joint time.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Thus $t^2=2$ and the positive time is $\sqrt2$.

problems.title: An integer perimeter fixes an obtuse angle
problems.question: Two sides are 3 and 4 cm with obtuse included angle $\alpha$. The perimeter is an integer. Find $\cos\alpha$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Because $\cos\alpha<0$, the opposite side satisfies $c>5$. The perimeter $7+c$ is integral, so $c$ is an integer.
The only integer with $5<c<7$ is 6. Thus $\cos\alpha=(25-36)/24=-11/24$.

problems.title: An altitude outside an obtuse triangle
problems.question: $A=45^\circ,C=120^\circ,AC=3-\sqrt3$. Find altitude $BH$ to line $AC$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The foot $H$ lies beyond $C$. Put $BH=h$. Triangle $ABH$ gives $AH=h$; triangle $BCH$ gives $CH=h/\sqrt3$.
Hence $AC=AH-CH=h(1-1/\sqrt3)=3-\sqrt3$. Solving yields $h=3$.

problems.title: Cancel a polynomial factor
problems.question: Reduce $(x^2+2x-8)/(x^2+7x+12)$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Cancel the common factor $x+4$. Keep the original exclusions $x\ne-4,-3$.

problems.title: Build an equation from its roots
problems.question: Which monic quadratic has roots $(\sqrt5-1)/2$ and $(-\sqrt5-1)/2$?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The root sum is $-1$ and the product is $(1-5)/4=-1$.
The equation is therefore $x^2+x-1=0$.

problems.title: Count ordered pairs
problems.question: How many ordered real pairs satisfy $x^2+y^2=13$, $xy=6$?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: For $x+y=5$, the numbers are 2 and 3; for $x+y=-5$, they are $-2,-3$.

problems.title: A bisector and a median divide a side
problems.question: $A:B:C=2:1:3$. Bisector $AL$ and median $AM$ meet $BC$. Find the three-part ratio starting from $C$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The angles are $60^\circ,30^\circ,90^\circ$, so $AB:AC=2:1$. Hence $CL=BC/3$.
The median gives $CM=BC/2$. Thus $CL:LM:MB=1/3:1/6:1/2=2:1:3$.

problems.title: The shortest median
problems.question: Find the shortest median of a triangle with sides 6,8,10.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: This formula decreases as the opposite side increases, since it also equals $\tfrac12\sqrt{2(a^2+b^2+c^2)-3a^2}$.
The shortest median is to side 10. The triangle is right, so that median is half the hypotenuse: 5.

problems.title: Positive coefficients determined by roots
problems.question: $t^2-pt+q=0$ has distinct roots $a,b$, with $1/a+1/b=2$ and $a^2+b^2=12$. Find positive $p,q$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Positivity gives $q=2,p=4$. The discriminant $16-8=8>0$ confirms distinct real roots.

problems.title: A sum is three times a difference
problems.question: Two positive numbers have sum three times their difference and product 10. Find their squared sum.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The relation gives $a=2b$. Then $2b^2=10$, so $b^2=5$ and $a^2=20$.

problems.title: A reciprocal substitution
problems.question: Find the sum of all real solutions of $(x^2+x-6)/x+x/(x^2+x-6)=5/2$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: The first produces $x^2-x-6=0$, whose root sum is 1. The second gives $x^2+x/2-6=0$, whose root sum is $-1/2$.
Both quadratics have two real roots and none is $0,2,-3$, the excluded values. Total root sum: $1-1/2=1/2$.

problems.title: A rational angle-bisector length
problems.question: $AB=27,AC=15,BC=14x$. Which listed $x$ makes bisector $AL$ rational?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: For listed $x=\sqrt6,\sqrt2,1,2\sqrt2,\sqrt5,2$, the squared lengths are respectively $135,315,360,45,180,225$.
Only 225 is a rational square, so $x=2$ gives $AL=15$. All listed sides satisfy the triangle inequality.

problems.title: Parallelogram sides and diagonals in equal ratios
problems.question: The sides have ratio $1:2$, and the diagonals also $1:2$. Find shorter diagonal divided by shorter side.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity or geometric relation and check all restrictions.
steps: Write sides $s,2s$ and diagonals $d,2d$. The identity gives $5d^2=10s^2$.
Therefore $d/s=\sqrt2$, taking positive lengths.
